headline: Estimated IPO price range is $70 to $78 per share
body: Anthropic said in an updated filing that it will offer 825 million shares at a price range between $70 and $78 per share. TechCrunch says the company could be worth $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the range, on a fully diluted basis.
note: The price range is the number to watch, and the company's filing sets it. The $1.404 trillion figure assumes the shares list at the top of that range.

evidence.text: Anthropic said it will offer 825 million shares in its upcoming IPO at a price range between $70 and $78 per share, according to an updated filing on Tuesday
The Claude-maker said in an updated IPO filing on Tuesday that it would be offering a total of 825 million Class A shares at an estimated price range of $70 to $78 per share.
The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
